target.title: fix(worker): keep artifact reads private by default
target.body:
## Summary

- keep brokered artifact reads signed by default even when a display base URL is configured
- require an explicit public-read opt-in and isolate every public grant behind a random 128-bit capability namespace
- expose the selected access policy in coordinator responses and document the secure migration path

Fixes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/904

## Verification

Exact candidate: `933b0c6ac0e8c9d854f2f18f25043b0014c249c8`.

- `npm test --prefix worker` (820 passed, 2 opt-in live tests skipped)
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `go test -race ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `node scripts/build-docs-site.mjs`
- added an opt-in R2 test that exercises Crabbox-generated presigned PUT/GET URLs, signs cleanup with the same ephemeral credential, and requires a post-delete 404
- exact-branch structured Codex autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings

## Live proof

- real Worker dry-run build completed with the production bindings
- the existing Cloudflare OAuth session completed a remote PUT, checksum-matched GET, DELETE, and confirmed-not-found canary against `openclaw-crabbox-artifacts`, leaving zero object residue
- exact Crabbox presigned PUT/GET/DELETE proof remains the pre-merge hold; it requires creating a short-lived object-read/write credential scoped only to that bucket, which is awaiting the action-time browser confirmation
